TITLE COMMITMENT AND EXCEPTIONS REPORT

Issued by: First American Title Insurance Company
Order Number: WA-2026-448122
Effective Date: April 3, 2026 at 8:00 a.m.

PROPERTY: 1418 Alder Ridge Drive, Bellevue, WA 98004
Lot 7, Block 3, Alder Ridge Estates
Tax Parcel No. 054730-0070-04

CURRENT VESTING: Douglas H. Kwan and Patricia N. Kwan, husband and wife, as tenants by the entireties, by Statutory Warranty Deed recorded May 18, 2014, King County Recording No. 20140518001842.

PROPOSED INSURED: Everett J. Osterhaus and Priya Rao Osterhaus, husband and wife
PROPOSED POLICY AMOUNT: $1,875,000.00 (Owner's, ALTA 2021 form)

SCHEDULE B — EXCEPTIONS
The Company excepts the following from coverage:

1. General property taxes for 2026, second half installment ($9,412.50), not yet due and payable.

2. Real estate excise tax due upon closing pursuant to RCW 82.45. Estimated at $28,687.50 (rate: 1.53%).

3. Assessments of the Alder Ridge Estates Homeowners Association pursuant to the Declaration of Covenants, Conditions, and Restrictions recorded May 3, 1968 under Recording No. 6394112 as amended by the First Amendment recorded September 20, 1994 under Recording No. 9409201188. Current assessment: $285.00 per quarter.

4. Easement in favor of Puget Sound Energy for underground electrical distribution, recorded October 4, 1968 under Recording No. 6425044, affecting the westerly 10 feet of the parcel.

5. Easement in favor of the City of Bellevue for storm drainage, recorded March 14, 1972 under Recording No. 7203144822, affecting the southeasterly 8 feet of the parcel.

6. **PENDING MECHANIC'S LIEN**: Claim of Lien filed by Cascade Peak Roofing, Inc. on February 28, 2026 under Recording No. 20260228000914 in the amount of $18,750.00 for materials and labor furnished for a partial roof replacement completed October 2019. Seller represents this lien is disputed and shall be removed prior to Closing.

7. Boundary discrepancy noted on the ALTA/NSPS Land Title Survey prepared by Barghausen Consulting Engineers on March 28, 2026: A cedar fence on the north property line encroaches approximately 1.4 feet onto the parcel of neighboring Lot 8 (owned by Nakamura). Buyer accepts this condition subject to a boundary line adjustment agreement to be recorded within 90 days of Closing.

8. Covenants, conditions, and restrictions in the recorded plat of Alder Ridge Estates, including but not limited to setback requirements (25 feet front, 10 feet side, 25 feet rear) and architectural review board approval for exterior modifications.

9. Rights of the public in and to any portion of the parcel lying within Alder Ridge Drive.

REQUIREMENTS TO CLOSE:
(a) Payoff and reconveyance of Deed of Trust dated May 18, 2014, recorded under Recording No. 20140518001843, in favor of Washington Federal Savings, principal balance approximately $612,000 as of April 3, 2026.
(b) Recordation of Release of Lien filed by Cascade Peak Roofing, Inc. (Item 6 above).
(c) Delivery of executed Statutory Warranty Deed from Douglas H. Kwan and Patricia N. Kwan.
(d) Payment of all closing costs and prorations per the settlement statement.
(e) Recordation of new Deed of Trust in favor of Buyer's lender (identified in Buyer's loan approval).

Title Officer: Alistair K. Braithwaite, First American Title
Escrow Officer: Naomi Tolentino, Cascade Escrow, LLC
